about: Every game system and hook HoloCraft touches. Each row is implemented by exactly one Java class (java column, relative to mod/src/main/java/fail/holocraft/); preflight fails while that file is missing. Other sheets reference rows here by id.

columns.attaches_to: string; the Minecraft/Fabric point it hooks (class#method or event), or 'sheet' for pure behaviour

rows.does: Fires 1+extra_hits projectiles at the nearest fans in range; each pierces N targets.
Half-circle sweep in front of the player; hits every fan inside the arc.
Straight stab toward the nearest fan; extra hits fan out in a V/fork.
Slows every fan within 32 blocks by power (0-1) and halves your cooldown for the duration.
Multiplies your idol damage by power for the duration.
Deals power x base damage to every fan within 8 blocks, then +50% damage and speed for the duration.
Ring of hits around you every 10 ticks for the duration, power x base damage, with knockback.
Fire nova of power x base damage; if you would die during the duration you are fully healed instead.
Every 6 s leaps at the nearest player and slams, hitting everything within 3 blocks.
Every 5 s winds up for 1 s then charges in a straight line at triple speed.
Multiplies HoloCure EXP picked up by 1+power.
Absorption hearts = power, refreshed every 15 s.
Idol cooldowns x(1-power), movement speed +power.
power chance for idol hits to deal 1.5x damage.
Eating heals power x max health.

Finds the player's HoloCure, reads data.win + audiogroups, writes the HoloCraft resource pack (textures, font, sounds, lang) to <instance>/holocraft/pack. Skips when the pack matches the HoloCure version.
Appends HoloPack as a resource pack provider; it runs the import on first scan and adds the generated pack as a required, top-priority pack.
If HoloCure could not be found, explains it once and links to its free Steam page.
HoloCure dialogue box with portrait, typed text and blip sound, for dialog rows.
HoloCure character-select screen on first join; the pick becomes hotbar slot 1.
Three HoloCure-style upgrade cards (new idol, weapon level, item); the pick is sent back to the server.
HoloCure EXP bar + level, special cooldown icon, night timer and boss bar.

Draws fans and bosses in the view the camera is in: from the Minecraft camera as animated thick pixel models (pixel_models) turned to their walk direction; from the top-down camera as the original flat HoloCure sprite (flat_view).
Draws attack and special effects (bullets, slashes, thrusts) from S2C fx packets.
Stage music at night, boss music while a boss lives.
Shows welcome dialog and the idol select to players with no idol yet.
Each player holding an idol auto-attacks with it on its cooldown.
Right-click fires the held idol's special when charged.
At dusk in the overworld starts the stage night: intro dialog, music, fan spawns that scale with minute and player count.
Spawns each boss at its night minute near a random player.
Shows the boss's defeat dialog; the last boss marks the stage cleared and skips to morning.
Fans drop HoloCure EXP gems; picking them up fills the HoloCure bar and triggers level-up picks.

HOLOCRAFT_HOST=1 (Melty sets it on every Play) opens the world to friends when it loads; the bundled e4mc relay carries it over the internet and writes 'Domain assigned: <address>' to latest.log, where Melty reads the join address; a friend's Prism joins with --launch HoloCraft --server <address>. Up to 8 players (Minecraft's limit for an opened world).
Every menu with no world open draws HoloCure's title background with idols drifting across it instead of the panorama.
Draws the HoloCraft logo (built from HoloCure's own title font) in place of the Minecraft logo and edition strip.
Bottom-left label reads 'HoloCraft <version> - Minecraft 1.21.4'.
HoloCraft's own splash lines.
Window title 'HoloCraft'.
HoloCure's sound effects are WAV, which Minecraft's sound engine cannot read; sounds mapped to a WAV play through HoloSfx (Java Sound) instead, scaled by Minecraft's volume sliders and distance.
Builds a HoloCure stage as a world: stone under a floor of stage ground blocks whose cells repeat the stage's floor texture, and every prop placement of the stage's room repeated across the map.
Reads where each prop stands in the stage room from the player's data.win (via the importer's stages/<id>.json).

Adds the stage as a World Type in Minecraft's Create World screen. The overworld uses holocraft:stage, Minecraft's overworld dimension with ambient light 0.45, so stage nights stay readable like HoloCure's.
HoloCure's stage biome: no vanilla monster spawns (fans come from WaveDirector), plains colours.
Draws each prop block in the view the camera is in: Minecraft camera = its pixel model built from the sprite by its shape3d/depth_px; top-down = left to flat_view, which draws the original sprite.

V switches between Minecraft's camera and HoloCure's top-down view and sets view_mode: camera fixed above the player looking straight down with an orthographic projection at HoloCure's pixel scale, north up, W/A/S/D move up/left/down/right on screen. Positions never change, only how the world is drawn.

rows.attaches_to: client state read by every renderer
rows.does: The one switch both views read: WORLD_3D or ORIGINAL_2D. Flipping it never moves anything.

Turns any HoloCure sprite frame into a thick pixel model (one box per opaque pixel run, Minecraft item-model style), as a single slab or two crossed slabs; built once per frame on the player's PC from their own data.win and cached.

rows.attaches_to: called by prop_renderer, sprite_renderer and player_as_idol while view_mode = ORIGINAL_2D
rows.does: Draws a sprite the way HoloCure does from above: flat on the ground plane with the sprite's top to the north, at the stage's map_px_per_block, lifted a hair per block further south so HoloCure's draw order (lower on screen = in front) falls out of the depth test. The ground needs nothing: straight down it is already the stage's floor tiles.
Every player is drawn as the idol in their hand (idle_sprite standing, run_sprite moving) instead of Steve, in both views; a player holding no idol is drawn as Steve.
While view_mode = ORIGINAL_2D the projection is orthographic and shows 640x360 HoloCure pixels at the stage's map_px_per_block, with no view bobbing or hurt tilt.
Skips vanilla's frustum back-off in the flat view: it waits for a 16-block box to fit inside a view 11 blocks tall, which an orthographic camera never satisfies, freezing the game.
No crosshair in the HoloCure view, as in HoloCure.
Creating or reopening a HoloCure stage world goes straight in, without vanilla's 'experimental settings' warning and backup prompt.
